author: Codehagen
name: hero-badge
description:
A versatile, animated badge component for highlighting new features, announcements, or important links.

Features:
	•	Smooth entrance animations
	•	Icon rotation on hover
	•	Multiple size variants
	•	Multiple style variants
	•	Link and button functionality
	•	Customizable icons
	•	Responsive design
	•	Accessibility features
Notes:
	•	Built with Framer Motion for smooth animations
	•	Uses React Server Components (RSC) with the "use client" directive
	•	Employs a responsive design with a mobile-first approach
	•	Includes interactive hover animations
	•	Supports TypeScript with proper types
	•	Allows for custom styling and theming
	•	Optimized performance through proper usage of hooks
